title: 细节题
goal: 听出原因、条件和时间地点，并核对选项中的同义改写。
exam: TOEFL iBT（2026 年 1 月起的新版）· 听力

sources.title: ETS：TOEFL iBT Test 2026 Update — Test Blueprint and Specifications
sources.used: 题量、难度范围、录音长度、只放一遍

sources.title: ETS：Updated TOEFL iBT Test Overview
sources.used: 各题型的说明、考查的能力、官方样题

sources.title: ETS：TOEFL iBT Listening Lesson Plans（教师用教案）
sources.used: 第 1 课：四类题的说明和小测答案；第 2、4 课：应答配对、重音和语调

body.p: 细节题考对话中明确说出的原因、条件、时间或地点。题干里的 why、when、where 和 what must 规定了要找哪一类信息。对话别处的真实细节，回答不了这一问。

body.box:
Why does the customer reject the first option?
Under what condition can the visitor enter?
When will the order be ready?
Where should the package be collected?

body.p: 选项通常改写原话。It won’t fit in my bag 可改写为 It is too large to carry in the bag。两句说的都是尺寸，不是重量。

steps.d: 题干问原因时，找动作和理由的对应。Why reject the box 对应 It’s too wide，与送货日期无关。
否定、转折和更正会改变前面的安排。Not at the front desk; use the side entrance 指定的是侧门，前台不是最终地点。
比较人物、动作、对象和条件是否一致。Only members may enter 与 Entry is restricted to members 同义，都只允许会员进入。

cards.title: 细节与限定
rows: 原因
because 后的理由须对应所问动作
I’m changing shoes because these pinch.
条件
only if 限定许可成立的前提
We can deliver only if someone is home.
时间点
by 是最迟时间，不是开始时间
Bring the costume back by noon.
时间段
until 表示状态持续的终点
The desk is staffed until six.
地点
区分咨询、领取和使用地点
Ask upstairs; collect the parcel downstairs.
更正
以后说的更正替换原安排
Not Tuesday. The repair will be ready Wednesday.
cards.note: 理由不一定含 because。These pinch. I need another pair 中，前一句直接解释换鞋原因。

cards.title: 同义改写
rows: 否定换反义
We don’t charge for delivery.
Delivery is free.
动词换名词
Someone must approve the design.
Approval is required.
具体换概括
I’m working when the shop is open.
The opening hours conflict with the customer’s work.
主动换被动
The technician will check the cable.
The cable will be inspected.
条件换表达
Show the pass before entering.
Entry requires a pass.
数量保留范围
At most two visitors may enter.
No more than two visitors are allowed.
cards.note: 改写不能扩大范围。Delivery is free 只说送货免费，不能改成 All services are free。

body.box:
Customer: Could the tailor shorten these trousers by Friday?
Assistant: The tailor's away on Thursday. Friday afternoon is possible, but only if they're left here before noon today.
Customer: I can leave them now. Should I collect them at this counter?
Assistant: At the fitting room upstairs. This counter only handles new orders.

What is required for the trousers to be ready on Friday?
1. Collecting them before noon
2. Leaving them today before midday
3. Waiting for the tailor on Thursday
4. Placing a new order upstairs

body.p: 题干问要求，依据是 only if they’re left here before noon today。第二项把 before noon 改写成 before midday，并保留了今天送来这个条件。
第一项把送来的时间当成了取件时间。第三项用的是裁缝不在的日期。第四项把 new orders 和 upstairs 拼在了一起。

cards.title: 干扰项
rows: 被否定的地点
选了 not 后面的地点，忽略了更正
Not at this counter; collect it upstairs.
相邻的时间
把店员不在的日子当成取件日
Away Thursday; ready Friday.
条件遗漏
把有条件的许可说成无条件
Only if left today → Ready regardless of arrival.
关系颠倒
把顾客送来说成店员送货
Leave them here → We will deliver them.
范围扩大
把一处的规定说成所有地方的规定
This counter handles new orders → All counters do.

lines.text: Can I pick up the repaired umbrella today?
The handle's fixed, but the glue needs to dry overnight. Tomorrow morning is fine.

items.stem: Why is the umbrella not ready for collection?
options: The handle still needs replacing.
The customer came after opening hours.
The adhesive needs more drying time.
The repair cannot begin until tomorrow.
items.why: 依据是 the glue needs to dry overnight。第三项的 adhesive 改写了 glue；把手已经修好。

lines.text: Can we bring our own chess set?
Yes. The tables are free to use as long as each player orders a drink.

items.stem: What is required to use the tables without a fee?
options: Each participant must buy a beverage.
Each participant must bring a chess set.
The group must pay for a table.
The group must order one shared drink.
items.why: 依据是 as long as each player orders a drink。每人都要点一杯饮料，即第一项；第四项说全组一杯，范围变小了。

lines.text: Does the repair desk close at five?
It stays open until six today, but the last repair is accepted at five.

items.stem: When must a customer arrive to leave an item for repair?
options: Before the desk closes at six
At five, when the desk closes today
After the last repair has been accepted
No later than five o'clock today
items.why: 依据是 the last repair is accepted at five。送修最晚五点，即第四项；六点是关门时间。

lines.text: The outdoor stall won't operate in this wind.
So the honey tasting is canceled?
No, it's moving inside the farmhouse.

items.stem: What has happened to the tasting?
options: It has been postponed until the wind stops.
It will be held indoors instead of outside.
It will remain at the outdoor stall.
It will be held both inside and outside.
items.why: 依据是 it's moving inside the farmhouse。品尝活动改在室内，即第二项；没有取消，也没有延期。

lines.text: I'd like to collect my repaired watch.
It's ready, but collections are at the service window behind this shop.
Do I need the paper receipt? I only have the message on my phone.
The message has the collection number, so that's enough. Show it at the window.

items.stem: Where should the customer collect the watch?
options: At the main sales counter
At the entrance to the shop
At a window behind the shop
At a service window inside this shop
items.why: 依据是 collections are at the service window behind this shop。取件在店后面的窗口，即第三项。

items.stem: What does the assistant say about the phone message?
options: It provides sufficient proof for collection.
It must be exchanged for a paper receipt.
It will arrive after the watch is collected.
It lacks the number needed for collection.
items.why: 依据是 The message has the collection number, so that's enough。凭手机消息就能取件，即第一项。

lines.text: I'd like to hire a cargo bike for tomorrow.
The small one is available, and so is the large one.
I'll carry a wide display board. It won't fit in the small carrier.
Then the large bike would work. It costs more, but the lock is included.
Fine. Can I return it at the station?
No, all our bikes come back to this workshop. The station only rents regular bikes.

items.stem: Why does the customer choose the larger bike?
options: The smaller bike is already rented.
The board is too wide for the small one.
The larger bike is cheaper to hire.
The smaller bike does not include a lock.
items.why: 依据是 I'll carry a wide display board. It won't fit in the small carrier。展示板太宽，小车放不下，即第二项；两种车都有。

items.stem: What does the employee say about returning the bike?
options: It can be returned wherever regular bikes are rented.
It must be returned to the station tomorrow.
It must go back to the place where this business operates.
It can be left at either the station or the workshop.
items.why: 依据是 all our bikes come back to this workshop。车必须还到这家店，即第三项；车站只租普通自行车。

lines.text: I'd like to join the evening bread-making session.
There's space, but it starts at six, not seven as the old leaflet says.
That's fine. Do I need to bring ingredients?
No, they're included. Bring a container for the loaf. Aprons are available here.
Great. I'll bring a box. I don't have an apron.
That's all right. The session fee covers borrowing one.

options: At six in the evening
At seven in the evening
An hour after seven
At the time on the old leaflet
items.why: 依据是 it starts at six, not seven as the old leaflet says。开始时间是六点，即第一项；七点是旧传单上的时间。

items.stem: What is included in the session fee?
options: A container for taking bread home
A new apron for each participant to keep
A separate box of ingredients to take away
Temporary use of an apron during the session
items.why: 依据是 The session fee covers borrowing one。one 指 apron，费用包含借用一条围裙，即第四项；围裙用完要还。

lines.text: I'm coming to the community radio interview tomorrow. Should I use the main entrance?
The main entrance will be closed for a delivery. Use the courtyard door instead.
Is that the door beside the bicycle racks?
Yes. Press the bell, and the producer will let you in. Please arrive fifteen minutes before the interview so we can check the microphone.
I'll be there early, then.

items.stem: Which entrance should the guest use?
options: The main entrance used for deliveries
The courtyard door by the bicycle racks
The main entrance after the delivery ends
Any door where the bell can be pressed
items.why: 依据是 Use the courtyard door instead 和 Is that the door beside the bicycle racks? Yes。要走自行车架旁的院门，即第二项；主入口关闭。

items.stem: Why should the guest arrive early?
options: To help unload the delivery
To move bicycles away from the door
To allow time for an equipment check
To interview the producer beforehand
items.why: 依据是 so we can check the microphone。第三项把检查麦克风概括为 equipment check。
